Send with
a little confidence.

Useful checks before you choose a courier.

Where can I send?

Explore sample routes between Kuala Lumpur, George Town, Johor Bahru, Ipoh, Kuching and Kota Kinabalu. These cities demonstrate the planner; actual coverage and collection availability depend on the courier you book.

Pack it well

Use a sturdy box, cushion each item, fill empty spaces and seal all seams. Remove old labels and place a spare address slip inside. Measure and weigh your sealed parcel before requesting a real quote.

Check restricted items

Check the chosen courier’s rules before sending batteries, liquids, perishables or valuable items. Dangerous goods, weapons and unlawful items require special restrictions or may be prohibited. This guide is a preparation checklist, not courier acceptance.

Damage, loss and support

Keep proof of value, packing photos and your receipt. Contact your booked courier for its claim process and deadlines. ParcelVex has no live customer-service or claims service connected yet.

Have these ready: tracking number, sender and recipient details, latest scan, booking receipt, item value and clear parcel photos. Share them directly with your booked courier.

A few things, unpacked.

Good questions.
Simple answers.

Can I book a real delivery here?

This is an interactive delivery concept. You can explore packaging, calculate sample prices, follow a demo shipment, and download a demo label. Booking and courier integrations are not connected.

How do the sample prices work?

The calculator combines an illustrative route charge, parcel-size charge, weight allowance, and delivery option. It updates as you adjust the controls. These are demonstration prices, not a courier quote.

Which tracking number can I try?

Use PV20261027. It opens a sample journey from Kuala Lumpur to George Town. Click the journey steps or play the route to explore each status.

What can I do with the 3D parcel?

Drag or use the arrow keys to rotate, click or press Space to unpack, choose a size and tape color, and add a care label. Switch to the van for another view. Everything works with touch, too.

Prefer less movement?

Your device’s reduced-motion preference is respected. The motion switch below pauses ambient movement and removes transition effects while keeping the delivery tools usable.
